trial_title: Observation Study of T-Gel (1%) in Treatment of Adolescent Boys With Hypogonadism
brief_summary: This study is to observe efficacy and safety after T-Gel 1% treatment in delayed puberty adolescents. Subjects who complete this trial may enter a 3 month extension study (UMD-01-090E).

eligibility_table.criterion: Primary or secondary hypogonadism or constitutional delay in growth and puberty (CDGP)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has hypogonadism, which qualifies under the inclusion criterion for primary or secondary hypogonadism.

eligibility_table.criterion: Skin intolerance to alcohol or allergy to soy
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding skin intolerance to alcohol or allergy to soy, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented history of skin intolerance to alcohol or an allergy to soy?

eligibility_table.justification: No information is available about generalized skin disease, so it cannot be determined.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any generalized skin disease as defined by the presence of lesions affecting more than 5% of the body surface area?

eligibility_table.criterion: Contraindication to testosterone or androgen products
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about contraindications to testosterone or androgen products, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of severe allergic reactions to testosterone or androgen products?
